user.title: Multi-Agent Router Setup
user.description: Configure your multi-agent routing system. Start by setting up the Prompt AI (required), then the Router AI, and add custom conversation agents.

prompt_ai.title: Configure Prompt AI
prompt_ai.description: Select the conversation agent that will generate routing prompts and configure its system prompt.

data_description.prompt_generator_agent: Agent that generates routing prompts (uses AI to create optimal prompts)
data_description.prompt_generator_prompt: The prompt template for the generator. Use {agent_json} as placeholder for agent data.

router_ai.title: Configure Router AI
router_ai.description: Select the conversation agent that will route user requests and configure its routing prompt.

data_description.agent: Select the conversation agent that will act as the router
data_description.agent_prompt: This prompt will be set as the router agent's system prompt. It tells the router how to classify requests and which agents to route to.

select_custom_ai.title: Select Custom AI to Edit
select_custom_ai.description: Choose which custom agent to edit.

add_agent.title: Custom AI Configuration
add_agent.description: Configure a specialized conversation agent that the router can direct requests to.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this agent
data_description.agent_prompt: Custom system prompt for this agent. Will be auto-filled from agent's current prompt if available.
data_description.description: Describe what types of requests this agent should handle
data_description.agent_keywords: Comma-separated keywords to help the router classify requests. Example: command, action, control, turn on, turn off

finish.title: Finish Setup
finish.description: Complete the setup. Ensure Prompt AI, Router AI, and at least one Custom AI are configured.

error.no_agents: You must configure at least one specialized agent.
error.no_custom_agents: At least one custom AI must be configured before finishing setup.
error.duplicate_name: An agent with this name already exists.
error.invalid_agent: The selected agent does not exist.
error.missing_prompt_ai: Prompt AI must be configured before finishing setup. Please configure it from the main menu.
error.missing_router_ai: Router AI must be configured before finishing setup. Please configure it from the main menu.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.
abort.no_agents: No conversation agents found. Please configure conversation agents (like OpenAI Conversation, Extended OpenAI Conversation, etc.) before setting up Multi-Agent Router.

init.description: Manage your multi-agent routing system configuration.

prompt_ai.description: Update the prompt generator agent configuration.

data_description.agent_prompt: The routing prompt used to classify requests
